Name: Cade Oosthuizen
Question: Can you provide examples of powerful villains who cannot be defeated by heroes, but can be easily defeated by other villains?
Answer: Does this guy count? Not really. And the examples are very few and far between because it makes for a bad story most of the time. If no hero can stand up to the villains of a universe, it’s just a dark dystopian piece. Not inspiring, no relatable arc, no classic structure.

Name: Cade Oosthuizen
Question: What would happen if the dark side of the force was destroyed?
Answer: The Sides aren't constants. So, nothing cataclysmic. The Dark Side being destroyed would just mean no one is abusing the Force. But the potential would always be there. Sooner or later, someone will come a long and decide “stuff the Light Side, how about my way/more power etc.?”

Name: Cade Oosthuizen
Question: What was your least favorite episode of The Mandalorian and why? Do you think it could have been improved or should not have been aired at all?
Answer: Episode 6 in Season 3 O, celebrity guests… so un-Star Wars, so very Disney There was no rescuing it, this should not have aired. It’s the embodiment of every bad thing in Season 3. Just pure filler and laziness. Very unneeded. The Mandalorian’s earlier seasons barely wasted a second. But season three barely had relevant episodes. It honestly felt like a SpongeBob episode with Star Wars character. The only good parts of the episode just didn't belong and should have been saved for a better episode.

Name: Cade Oosthuizen
Question: What happened to General Grievous after Revenge of the Sith? Where is he during A New Hope? How come we never see him again in any other movie after that one?
Answer: Well, It would make sense that we don’t see him after this: Kenobi got him with multiple blaster bolts straight to vital organs (the last he had left) General Grievous was as dead as dead could be.

Name: Cade Oosthuizen
Question: Which Star Wars faction is your favorite and why?
Answer: The Galactic Republic of course! Its grand army (the clone army) is one of the coolest in all of fiction! They are part of one of the best plots in Star Wars in my opinion. Plus, they are powerful, advanced, they have heart, and they look really cool.
